note: v500: Paying off a loan now shows the right number. "Remaining Balance" is the balance as of your last payment — pay exactly that a month later and one month's interest is still owing, which is why a full payment left $195.01 behind. The card now says which date it's good for, a "Pay off today" line shows the balance plus the interest since then, and the payment sheet has a "Pay off in full" button that re-quotes as you change the date. Recording that amount clears the loan to zero.
